problemFilterSection.problemFilterSectionGroup_message_0Regex: Filter by <0>regular expression</0>: each entry is one regular expression, and every problem item it matches (at any position) is dropped. For example <1>missing.*punctuation</1> or <2>^leftover Japanese: ♪</2>. <3>In principle, only filter subcategories</3>: whole-category entries such as <4>leftover Japanese</4> or <5>^leftover Japanese:</5> also hide the real problems inside the big category, so they are not recommended. To filter one specific entry literally, escape the special characters (clicking the - sign after a problem item on the “Browse text” page escapes them for you).
problemFilterSection.problemFilterSectionGroup_message_cacheF: Exempt specific translations with “cache file name:index”, which is the same as ticking skip_check for that entry: it is no longer checked and no longer counted in statistics. index accepts a closed range (e.g. 01.json:12-15).

splitFile.label: File splitting
splitFile.description: Single-file split mode: no disables splitting, Num slices by sentence count, and Equal divides the file into equal parts.

splitFileNum.label: Split count
splitFileNum.description: In Num mode, the number of sentences per part; in Equal mode, the total number of parts.

splitFileCrossNum.label: Split overlap sentences
splitFileCrossNum.description: Number of overlapping sentences between parts, which improves how well segments connect (0 or 10 are common).

linebreakSymbol.label: Line break symbol
linebreakSymbol.description: The line break type inside JSON, used by problem detection and auto-fixing.

save_steps.label: Cache save frequency
save_steps.description: Save the cache after every N batches.

loggingLevel.label: Log level
loggingLevel.description: debug for details, info for the normal case, warning for warnings only.

saveLog.label: Save logs to file
saveLog.description: Whether the run log is written to a file.

workersPerProject.label: Concurrent files
workersPerProject.description: How many files are processed in parallel at the project level; parallel work inside a single file also needs “File splitting” under “File I/O”.

gpt_numPerRequestTranslate.label: Sentences per request
gpt_numPerRequestTranslate.description: How many sentences are packed into each request; 16 or fewer is recommended.

gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate.label: Dynamic sentence count
gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate.description: When enabled, the sentence count drops automatically on model parse errors and rises again once things are stable.

gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate_min.label: Dynamic minimum sentences
gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate_min.description: The lowest per-request sentence count the dynamic adjustment may fall to.

gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate_max.label: Dynamic maximum sentences
gpt_dynamicNumPerRequestTranslate_max.description: The highest per-request sentence count the dynamic adjustment may rise to.

language.label: Target language
language.description: The output language of the translation.

sortBy.label: Translation order
sortBy.description: name sorts by file name, size puts large files first (usually faster when running in parallel).

gpt_multiTurn.label: Multi-turn translation
gpt_multiTurn.description: Enabled by default for ForGal / ForNovel; consecutive batches share the conversation so character names and writing style stay consistent.

gpt_contextNum.label: Context sentences
gpt_contextNum.description: How many previous sentences are added when a multi-turn session starts or resets; sent with every request when multi-turn is off. 0 means no previous context; 8 is common.

gpt_translation_guideline.label: Translation guidelines
gpt_translation_guideline.description: The global translation guideline file (located in the translation_guidelines folder). This project’s own guidelines are on the “Project guidelines” page on the left; during translation they are appended to the global ones and win on conflicts.

gpt_multiTurn_maxTurns.label: Maximum turns per session
gpt_multiTurn_maxTurns.description: Request turns per session for ForGal / ForNovel, 8 by default; a new session starts once this is reached.

gpt_multiTurn_maxChars.label: Session character budget
gpt_multiTurn_maxChars.description: The character budget for the history (including thinking) and new requests, 24000 by default; a new session starts once it is exceeded, and a single batch is never truncated.

start_time.label: Scheduled start
start_time.description: Time in 24-hour format (e.g. 00:30); leave it empty to start immediately.

skipH.label: Skip sensitive sentences
skipH.description: Whether sentences that may trigger sensitive-word detection are skipped.

smartRetry.label: Smart retry
smartRetry.description: Shrinks the batch and resets the context automatically when parsing fails, reducing useless retries.

retranslFail.label: Retranslate failed sentences
retranslFail.description: Whether sentences marked (Failed) are retranslated automatically on startup.

gpt_enhance_jailbreak.label: Reduce refusals
gpt_enhance_jailbreak.description: When enabled, the model refuses less often.

gpt_token_limit.label: Token limit (Sakura)
gpt_token_limit.description: The per-turn token limit in Sakura scenarios; 0 means no limit.
